registry.custodian: Oyo State Government Ministry of Lands, Housing and Urban Development and the Oyo State Office of the Surveyor General; OyoGISS is the state geographic-information and land-administration service.
registry.localOffice: Oyo State Ministry of Lands, Housing and Urban Development / Office of the Surveyor General, with OyoGISS state coverage including Iseyin.
registry.sourceScope: The official OyoGISS page describes a state platform for capturing, storing, managing and analyzing geographic data for land administration and says properties in all 33 LGAs were digitized. The official land-use-charge page has an ISEYIN row. This establishes local state registry/GIS context, not open parcel-geometry access.
registry.geometryAccess: No credentials, private tokens, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, or owner/address/titleholder/personal fields were used. The official linked survey-search application returned HTTP 403 from Cloudflare to an anonymous GET; no JavaScript/configuration or feature endpoint was inspected beyond the public procedure page.

geometry.exactWupPointTest: Not performed against a public parcel feature service. The 403 response from the linked search application and absence of a public feature endpoint are not evidence of citywide absence.

runtimeReadiness.reason: A local Oyo State land/GIS and survey-registry custodian with Iseyin/statewide context is evidenced, but no anonymous safe-ID geometry response, schema, CRS, or independently qualified adapter was found.
